dump.evaluationRule: Fusion evaluates conditions in order and stops at the first false one, so a Random in a condition is drawn only when every earlier condition holds; the Android timer (CND_EVERY2) counts down by real elapsed ms only when reached

model.note: plant-model.js draws only gameplay rolls (unit movement, Foxy, BB, Golden Freddy, Puppet, cooldowns, g744); no cosmetic, camera-view, monitor-down, blackout or Paper Pals draws

consequence: The game spends at least ~84 draws per second unconditionally, plus state-dependent per-frame draws (camera views, monitor-down image, blackout, static glitches); the model spends almost none, so its stream diverges from the phone's from the first frame for every seed.

Seed-specific encounter predictions and seed scoring on the current model cannot identify a phone night even at the true seed; the modest rank signals in docs/evidence/night7-k3-twin-nights-result-20260915.json are most likely coincidence. Rates are unaffected.
g822 draws once per rendered frame, so aligning the stream also needs the phone's real frame count between the seed and each roll (a dropped frame shifts every later draw by one).
